hero.description: Start HN is an accounting agency dedicated to the growth and success of entrepreneurs and small businesses in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

welcome.tagline: Every day we prove that expertise and clear financial reporting build a solid foundation for new business opportunities.
welcome.para1: Start HN accounting agency from Sarajevo supports associations, sole traders, and micro, small, and medium-sized businesses. Our work is grounded in timeliness, expertise, and trust — we ensure all legal obligations are fulfilled on time.
welcome.para2: From the very beginning our goal was clear: combine accounting precision with process digitalisation. We believe accounting is not just a record of the past — it is a tool for making timely business decisions. That is why we offer digital solutions that give clients continuous access to their data, alongside a traditional approach for those who prefer physical or email delivery.
welcome.para3: Alongside regular bookkeeping, we provide added value through our Virtual CFO service — strategic financial advisory and in-depth business analysis. We also have a special place for startups, offering benefits and full support from day one.

intro.heading: What Sets Us Apart
intro.para1: In accounting, trust is not just a word — it is built on expertise, legality, and responsibility. For us at Start HN, every certificate and every official confirmation is much more than a document: it is proof that our work passes the strictest checks, that we respect regulations, and that we uphold professional and ethical standards.
intro.para2: Through years of investment in knowledge, education, and development, we have obtained licences and recognitions that confirm our commitment to our clients and the quality of the services we provide. They are also a guarantee that you can choose us with full confidence, knowing that we are building your business on solid and legal foundations.

listings.title: Certified Accountant
listings.summary: Lead bookkeeping and financial reporting for our small and medium-sized business clients.
responsibilities: Prepare financial statements (balance sheet, income statement)
Reconcile accounts, cash registers, and bank statements
Collaborate with auditors and tax advisors
requirements: Bachelor's degree in accounting or finance (VI/VII level)
Minimum 3 years' experience in an accounting agency
Excellent knowledge of local accounting standards and regulations
Proficiency in accounting software (Pantheon, iCenter, or similar)
offers: Positive work environment and team support

listings.title: Tax Advisor
listings.summary: Guide clients through tax planning, compliance, and representation before the Tax Authority.
responsibilities: Advise clients on tax planning and optimisation
Prepare and file tax returns (VAT, income tax, corporate tax)
Monitor regulatory changes and keep clients informed
Represent clients in communications with the Tax Authority
requirements: Degree in accounting, law, or a related field
Analytical skills and strong attention to detail
offers: Professional development and tax law training
Dynamic team in a pleasant work environment

listings.title: Junior Accountant
listings.summary: Support senior accountants with bookkeeping, document control, and financial reporting preparation.
responsibilities: Perform administrative tasks related to accounting
requirements: Secondary or bachelor's degree in accounting or economics (IV/VI level)
Attention to detail and strong organisational skills

listings.title: Office Manager / Administrative Assistant
listings.summary: Keep our office running smoothly — client reception, document management, and internal coordination.
responsibilities: Greet clients and manage communications (phone, email)
Coordinate internal processes and support the team
requirements: Secondary or higher education, preferably in economics or administration
